item.title: github: Accessibility statements highlighted on repository overview
item.description:
GitHub now highlights an ACCESSIBILITY.md file on the repository overview when it is located in the repository root, .github/, or docs/. The changelog entry also notes support for adding or proposing an accessibility statement file.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Ask Copilot for a repository overview
item.description:
GitHub Copilot can now provide a high-level overview of a repository from the repository home page. The feature is meant to help users quickly understand repositories they are exploring for the first time.

  • Source: GitHub
